Jill (Marketing): Heads-up: planning to publish the 'Latency & Cost: Redwood Benchmarks' blog next Thu 9:00 AM PT. Need legal ok + exec quote by Wed EOD. @Rina @Carlos

Carlos (Product): Will verify numbers and drop final chart PNG into /marketing/assets. Please call out test harness and model versions in a footnote.

Rina (Legal): Will review for claims and IP issues. Please avoid 'worldest' phrasing unless supported. Add the footnote as requested.

Ava (PR): Recommend embargo 8:30 AM PT. I'll prepare a short press kit and outreach list (TechCrunch, The Verge, Bloomberg). Do we want an advance teaser for key partners?

Jill (Marketing): Yes, teaser to partners only. Checklist: legal signoff (Rina), exec quote (Carlos to secure), chart asset (Carlos), press kit (Ava), publish job (PublishBot).

PublishBot: Scheduled publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-04-08T16:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-04-08T15:30:00Z, job_id=100412.

Carlos (Product): Uploaded chart v3: /marketing/assets/benchmarks-v3.png. Footnote: "Benchmarks performed on our standard harness; results may vary."

Rina (Legal): :thumbsup: legal signoff provided, removed unsubstantiated phrasing and added footnote.

Ava (PR): Shared embargoed press kit to the thread DM. Holding sends until you confirm publish time.

Jill (Marketing): Great. Please react :thumbsup: to confirm readiness. We'll only go live after all thumbs-ups.

Carlos (Product): :thumbsup:

Rina (Legal): :thumbsup:

Ava (PR): :thumbsup:

Jill (Marketing): Thanks team, will monitor and announce internally once live.
